Aurora Blender Model AB-200 Product Data Sheet

Document No: PEG-DS-2024-0143
Revision: 1.2
Effective Date: 15 May 2024
Prepared by: Product Engineering Group
Classification: Public – for distribution to retailers, distributors, and regulatory bodies

1. Product Identification

Aurora Blender Model AB-200 has_model_number AB-200. Record status: current. This designation is the current controlled model identifier and supersedes all preliminary designations used during development (including the pre-production "AB-200P" tag). The model number appears on the rating plate affixed to the base of the unit and on the individual carton label.

2. Intended Use

The AB-200 is a domestic countertop blender intended for the preparation of beverages, smoothies, sauces, and similar food items. It is designed for intermittent household use with a maximum continuous operating cycle of 60 seconds, followed by a minimum rest period of 2 minutes. The appliance is not intended for commercial or industrial applications.

3. Physical Specifications

| Parameter | Specification |
|---|---|
| Overall height (including lid) | 385 mm |
| Base diameter | 165 mm |
| Base height | 95 mm |
| Jar capacity (nominal) | 1.5 L |
| Jar capacity (max fill line) | 1.25 L |
| Jar material | Tritan™ copolyester, BPA-free |
| Jar finish | Translucent, tinted charcoal grey |
| Lid material | Polypropylene (PP) with silicone gasket |
| Lid type | Two-part: central measuring cap (50 mL) with vent slot; twist lock |
| Blade assembly | 4-point stainless steel, fixed base, removable for cleaning |
| Blade diameter | 100 mm |
| Base housing material | ABS, matte black finish |
| Base housing weight | 1.4 kg |
| Total unit weight (with jar) | 2.1 kg |
| Cord length | 0.9 m |
| Cord type | Detachable, magnetic connection, 2-pin |

4. Electrical Ratings

| Parameter | Specification |
|---|---|
| Voltage | 220–240 V AC, 50 Hz |
| Rated power | 700 W |
| Motor type | Universal, brushed |
| Motor speed (no load) | 24,000 RPM |
| Speed settings | 2 speed + pulse |
| Speed 1 (low) | 12,000 RPM (under load approx. 9,000 RPM) |
| Speed 2 (high) | 20,000 RPM (under load approx. 15,000 RPM) |
| Protection class | Class II (double insulated) |
| IP rating | IPX0 (not for immersion) |
| Standby power | < 0.5 W |

5. Materials and Compliance

All materials that come into contact with food comply with the requirements of the Australia New Zealand Food Standards Code – Standard 3.2.2 (Food Safety Practices and General Requirements) and relevant sections of the Food Standards Australia New Zealand (FSANZ) guidance for food contact materials. The Tritan jar is free of bisphenol A (BPA) and phthalates. The stainless steel blade assembly is grade 304 (18/8) and is resistant to pitting and staining from common food acids. The ABS base housing contains no halogenated flame retardants.

The product is manufactured in accordance with the following standards:
- AS/NZS 60335.2.14:2020 (Household and similar electrical appliances – Safety – Particular requirements for kitchen machines)
- AS/NZS 60335.1:2020 (General requirements)
- AS/NZS CISPR 14.1:2020 (Electromagnetic compatibility – Requirements for household appliances)

A Declaration of Conformity has been lodged with the Australian Communications and Media Authority (ACMA) and the relevant state electrical safety regulators. The RCM (Regulatory Compliance Mark) is applied to the rating plate.
| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Interlock switch | Motor will not operate unless the jar is correctly seated on the base and the lid is locked in place. |
| Thermal cut-out | Motor is protected by a self-resetting thermal cut-out that activates if the unit is operated continuously at high speed for more than 3 minutes. |
| Overload protection | Electronic current limiter disables the motor if the load exceeds the rated duty cycle. |
| Non-slip feet | Four suction feet on the base prevent movement during operation. |
| Ventilated base | Air vents in the base housing prevent overheating; do not block these vents. |
| Cord storage | The detachable cord can be wound around the base storage posts when not in use. |

The interlock switch is a mechanical device and does not rely on software. If the jar is lifted while the motor is running, the motor stops within 0.5 s. The thermal cut-out resets automatically when the motor cools to a safe temperature; no manual reset is required.

8. Environmental Conditions

The unit is rated for indoor household use only. Operating temperature range is 5 °C to 40 °C. Relative humidity up to 90% (non-condensing) is acceptable. The unit is not to be used outdoors or in damp or wet environments. The IPX0 rating indicates that the unit is not protected against the ingress of water and must not be immersed or rinsed under running water. Only the jar, lid, and blade assembly are dishwasher-safe; the base housing must be wiped clean with a damp cloth only.

9. Compliance Markings and Labelling

The following markings appear on the rating plate located on the underside of the base housing:

- Model number: AB-200
- Rated voltage: 220–240 V AC, 50 Hz
- Rated power: 700 W
- Protection class: Class II (double insulated)
- RCM (Regulatory Compliance Mark)
- Manufacturer name and address
- Date of manufacture in YYYY-MM-DD format
- Serial number (unique per unit)

Aurora Blender Model AB-200 has_manufacture_date 2024-05-15 date. Record status: current. The date of manufacture is printed on the rating plate and on the carton. The serial number is also printed on the carton and on the underside of the base housing.

The RCM is applied in accordance with the requirements of the Australian Communications and Media Authority (ACMA) and the relevant state electrical safety regulators. A Declaration of Conformity has been lodged and is available on request from the manufacturer.

10. Packaging

The product is supplied in a single carton containing:

- Blender base unit
- Blending jar (1.5 L, Tritan)
- Lid with central measuring cap
- Blade assembly (pre-installed in jar)
- Detachable power cord
- User manual
- Quick start guide
- Warranty card

The carton is printed with the model number, a barcode (EAN-13), and the following handling symbols: "This Way Up", "Fragile", and "Keep Dry". The carton weight is 2.6 kg including all accessories.

11. Warranty

This product is covered by a 24-month consumer warranty in accordance with the Australian Consumer Law. The warranty period commences on the date of original purchase. Proof of purchase is required for any warranty claim. The warranty does not cover damage resulting from misuse, accidental damage, normal wear and tear, or failure to follow the instructions in the user manual. The warranty is provided by Aurora Appliances Pty Ltd, Sydney, Australia. For warranty claims, contact the retailer of purchase or Aurora Appliances customer service.
11. Warranty (continued)

The warranty card included in the carton must be completed and returned to Aurora Appliances within 14 days of purchase to activate the extended warranty benefits described below. Registration can also be completed online at www.auroraappliances.com.au/register using the serial number printed on the rating plate. Failure to register does not affect the consumer's statutory rights under the Australian Consumer Law.

In addition to the statutory guarantees, Aurora Appliances Pty Ltd provides a voluntary extended warranty covering the motor and gearbox assembly for a period of 60 months from the date of purchase. This extended warranty applies only to the motor and gearbox, and does not cover the blending jar, lid, measuring cap, blade assembly, or any other consumable or accessory. The extended warranty is subject to the same exclusions as the standard 24-month consumer warranty, including misuse, accidental damage, and failure to follow the user manual instructions.

For the avoidance of doubt, the 24-month consumer warranty and the 60-month extended warranty both commence on the date of original purchase, not on the date of manufacture. The date of manufacture, printed on the rating plate and on the carton, is provided for traceability and does not alter the warranty commencement date.

12. Accessories and Spare Parts

The following accessories and spare parts are available for the Aurora Blender Model AB-200. They can be ordered from Aurora Appliances customer service or from authorised retailers. Availability of each item is subject to change without notice.

| Item | Part Number | Description |
|------|-------------|-------------|
| Blending jar, 1.5 L, Tritan | AB-200-JAR | Replacement jar with graduations in mL and cup markings |
| Lid with measuring cap | AB-200-LID | Replacement lid with central measuring cap (50 mL capacity) |
| Blade assembly | AB-200-BLADE | Replacement blade assembly, pre-installed in a new jar |
| Detachable power cord | AB-200-CORD | Replacement power cord, 1.2 m length |
| Measuring cap only | AB-200-CAP | Replacement central measuring cap |
| Sealing ring | AB-200-RING | Replacement silicone sealing ring for the jar base |
| Jar base collar | AB-200-COLLAR | Replacement collar that secures the blade assembly to the jar |

The sealing ring and jar base collar are considered wear items and are not covered by the warranty. Recommended replacement interval for the sealing ring is every 12 months or sooner if leakage is observed.

13. Disposal and Environmental Information

The product contains no hazardous substances as defined by the RoHS Directive. At the end of its service life, the product should be disposed of in accordance with local council regulations for electronic waste. The Tritan jar is recyclable in most Australian kerbside recycling programs, provided it is separated from the blade assembly and base unit. The blade assembly should be disposed of with general waste or metal recycling, depending on local council guidelines.

The packaging carton is made from recycled cardboard and is recyclable. The plastic inserts inside the carton are marked with recycling codes and should be disposed of according to local council guidelines.

14. Technical Specifications Summary

|-----------|-------|
| Model | AB-200 |

| Carton weight (including all accessories) | 2.6 kg |
| Protection class | Class II (double insulated) |
| Noise level | ≤ 78 dB(A) at 1 m (high speed) |
| Duty cycle | 1 minute on, 2 minutes off (high speed) |

1. Product Identification

2. Intended Use

The AB-200 is a domestic countertop blender intended for the preparation of beverages, smoothies, sauces, and similar food items. It is designed for intermittent household use with a maximum continuous operating cycle of 60 seconds, followed by a minimum rest period of 2 minutes. The appliance is not intended for commercial or industrial applications.

| Feature | Description |

| Interlock switch | Motor will not operate unless the jar is correctly seated on the base and the lid is locked in place. |
| Thermal cut-out | Motor is protected by a self-resetting thermal cut-out that activates if the unit is operated continuously at high speed for more than 3 minutes. |

The interlock switch is a mechanical device and does not rely on software. If the jar is lifted while the motor is running, the motor stops within 0.5 s. The thermal cut-out resets automatically when the motor cools to a safe temperature; no manual reset is required.

8. Environmental Conditions

The unit is rated for indoor household use only. Operating temperature range is 5 °C to 40 °C. Relative humidity up to 90% (non-condensing) is acceptable. The unit is not to be used outdoors or in damp or wet environments. The IPX0 rating indicates that the unit is not protected against the ingress of water and must not be immersed or rinsed under running water. Only the jar, lid, and blade assembly are dishwasher-safe; the base housing must be wiped clean with a damp cloth only.

9. Compliance Markings and Labelling

The following markings appear on the rating plate located on the underside of the base housing:

- Model number: AB-200

The RCM is applied in accordance with the requirements of the Australian Communications and Media Authority (ACMA) and the relevant state electrical safety regulators. A Declaration of Conformity has been lodged and is available on request from the manufacturer.

This product is covered by a 24-month consumer warranty in accordance with the Australian Consumer Law. The warranty period commences on the date of original purchase. Proof of purchase is required for any warranty claim. The warranty does not cover damage resulting from misuse, accidental damage, normal wear and tear, or failure to follow the instructions in the user manual. The warranty is provided by Aurora Appliances Pty Ltd, Sydney, Australia. For warranty claims, contact the retailer of purchase or Aurora Appliances customer service.

The warranty card included in the carton must be completed and returned to Aurora Appliances within 14 days of purchase to activate the extended warranty benefits described below. Registration can also be completed online at www.auroraappliances.com.au/register using the serial number printed on the rating plate. Failure to register does not affect the consumer's statutory rights under the Australian Consumer Law.

In addition to the statutory guarantees, Aurora Appliances Pty Ltd provides a voluntary extended warranty covering the motor and gearbox assembly for a period of 60 months from the date of purchase.
